description_html:
Emergency pod. Hours after NVIDIA announced that Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO, Jordan Nanos (@JordanNanos) sits down with Dylan Patel (@dylan522p) and ChinaTalk's Jordan Schneider (@jordanschnyc). They get into why the MATCH Act matters more than RASA, how much compute China should be allowed to rent abroad, the smuggling cases around NVIDIA's supply chain, China's push onto domestic accelerators, whether NVIDIA can execute without its founder, and who should run it next. Then it goes off the rails.


Read the article: https://newsletter.semianalysis.com/p/nvidia-and-the-world-without-jensen

ChinaTalk: https://www.chinatalk.media

2:04 MATCH Act vs RASA

5:06 Why Not Ban Everything

9:21 Will China Retaliate

15:54 The Smuggling Evidence

21:09 China's Domestic Chips

23:08 Flip the Table

29:03 Open Models and Talent

31:10 NVIDIA Without Jensen

41:46 Who Runs NVIDIA Next

45:48 Closing Thoughts

47:56 The Nationalization Debate


The indictments discussed are allegations; defendants are presumed innocent. Opinions are the speakers' own. Not financial advice.
